metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.9 · 1995 · Species
metas.description: A group of scientists try to track down and trap a killer alien seductress before she successfully mates with a human.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.6 · 1998 · Species II
metas.description: An astronaut gets infected with alien DNA during the first mission on Mars and runs amok on earth. Preston and Laura team up with a peaceful, genetically re-engineered Sil to track the monster down.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.2 · 2004 · Species III
metas.description: As her species decays succumbing to infections and illnesses, an alien seductress immunologically stronger becomes the only hope for them to live on.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.9 · 2007 · Species: The Awakening
metas.description: When she reaches the end of her lifespan, a scientist rushes to Mexico, in order to save the half-breed alien seductress he raised as his docile niece, but soon awakens the deadly, sexual predator inside her.
